subject.title: fix(gateway): admit plugin HTTP work during suspension

question: Is a redacted exact-head real Gateway suspension run required before this protected PR can merge, or should the focused Testbox evidence receive an explicit proof override?
rationale: The patch appears correct, but repository policy treats tests and CI as supplemental for external PRs and the current head has no observed after-fix real-setup artifact.

options.title: Require live proof
options.body: Wait for terminal output, logs, or a linked artifact showing the full held-work, 503 rejection, and status/resume sequence on the exact head.

options.title: Grant proof override
options.body: Explicitly accept the focused Testbox and CI evidence without a separate real-setup artifact for this internal lifecycle boundary.

recommendation.title: Require live proof
recommendation.body: Wait for terminal output, logs, or a linked artifact showing the full held-work, 503 rejection, and status/resume sequence on the exact head.

likelyOwner.reason: They introduced the suspension feature and have the strongest merged history on the affected lifecycle boundary.
